task: six-class coarse action recognition; NOT SOP violation detection

metrics.experiment: VisualSOP V6 fine-tuned R3D-18 motion ROI
metrics.model: Kinetics400 R3D18 fine-tuned layer4 + six-class head

limitations: 16 historically reused test segments, 14 from group 9021
Only 62 independent train action intervals from 8 source sessions and four toy groups
Validation has 17 intervals and was repeatedly used for tuning across versions
Motion ROI based on pixel differences is heuristic and may focus irrelevant movement
Only 13/350 annotated sessions paired with videos
No real SOP violation labels and no industrial safety certification
Do not publish source videos, observe gated CC BY-NC 4.0 terms
